qa_pairs.question: Which component has a higher torque specification - the rocker arm clamping bolt or the drag arm clamping bolt?
qa_pairs.answer: The rocker arm clamping bolt has a higher torque specification at 10 Nm compared to the drag arm clamping bolt at 8 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What type designation applies to the rocker arm clamping bolt?
What is the difference in torque specifications between the rocker arm and drag arm clamping bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: 2 Nm (rocker arm is 10 Nm, drag arm is 8 Nm)

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection covers the rocker arms/drag arms and bearings specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 11-23 Engine, subsection 11 33 Rocker Arms/Drag Arms and Bearings
